NIT REF. NO. SMLT/MMP/407/1000072941 1. PAYMENT TERM- A) 100% payment shall be released through e-mode within 10 days of CRAC. B) Payment of GST will be released subject to reflection of seller's invoice in GSTR 2a/anx- 2(GST new retur n) of NALCO. 2. GUARANTEE/WARRANTY & TEST CERTIFICATES TEST CERTIFICATE: TEST CERTIFICATE FOR TOTAL GSM, BREAKING LOAD (MD & TD) AND WATER PENETRA TION TEST FROM CIPET OR ANY NABL ACREDITED TEST HOUSE AND MANUFACTURER'S TEST CERTIFICATE FOR CONTINUOUS CONDENSATION TEST SHALL BE SUBMITTED ALONGWITH THE SUPPLY OF MATERIAL. IF REQUIRED NALCO MAY TEST ANY PART OF ANY LOT OF MATERIAL AT CIPET, THE RESULT OF WHICH SHALL BE BINDING ON THE VENDOR. 3. DELIVERY SCHEDULE:- A. In case of splitting @60:40 1. Delivery schedule for 60% of the mater ial (144000MTr) 1st Lot: Minimum 10,000 MTr must reach the Smelter Plant within 1 month (30 days) from the date of GEM C placement. Balance Quantity: To be supplied in three lots at a minimum of 30,000 MTr per lot, with a 30- day interval between consecutive lots. Total Maximum Delivery Period: 4 months (120 days) from the date of GEMC placement. 2.Delivery schedule for 40% of the material(96000MTr) --1st Lot: Minimum 10,000 MTr must reach the Smelter Plant within 1 month (30 days) from the date of GE MC placement. Balance Quantity: To be supplied in three lots at a minimum of 25,000 MTr per lot, maintai ning a 45-day gap between consecutive lots. Total Maximum Delivery Period: 5.5 months (approx. 165 day s) from the date of GEMC placement. B. In case of No splitting(100%)- --Delivery schedule for 100% of the material (240000MTr) 1st Lot: Minimum 20,000 MTr must reach the Smelter Plant within 1 month (30 days) from the date of GEM PO placement. Balance Quantity: Delivery to be completed at a minimum of 30,000 MTr per lot across 4 lo ts, with a 30-day interval between consecutive lots. Total Maximum Delivery Period: 5 months (150 days) f rom the date of GEM PO placement. 4. EARNEST MONEY DEPOSIT (EMD): Tenderers are required to submit interest free EMD of value as mentioned in the bid document. I) Acceptable modes of EMD: EMD may be accepted in the following forms: A) Bank guarantee (including e-bank guarantee) from banks acceptable to Nalco as per format of N alco provided in ATC attachment, valid for 45 days beyond the required validity of bid. B) In the form of TT remittance/ online transfer - NEFT, RTGS, SWIFT. C) Account payee demand draft, fixed deposit receipt, banker’s cheque, etc. From a commercial bank .

The proof of such transfer/ transaction needs to be submitted with the offer. However, EMD will not be acc epted in cash. II) Exemption from submission of EMD: All EMD exemption criteria mentioned in GeM GTC shall be ap plicable in this tender. III) Execution and application of EMD: the EMD will be returned to all unsuccessful bidders within 15 w orking days after finalization of the order. However, in case of two packet or two stage bidding, Bid securiti es of unsuccessful bidders during first stage i.e. technical evaluation should be returned within 15 days of declaration of result of first stage itself i.e. technical evaluation. The EMD of the successful bidder will be returned after they accept the order, submit contract cum perfor mance bank guarantee (CPBG)/security deposit (SD) and bank confirmation of the SD/CPBG thereafter as t he case may be. In case where submission of SD/CPBG is not a condition of tender, EMD of successful bidder will be release d after successful execution of the order. In case where submission of SD /CPBG is a condition of purchase order and if the successful bidder accepts the order but fails to submit the contract cum performance bank guarantee (CPBG)/security deposit (SD), t he EMD shall be retained. In such cases the differential amount towards contract cum performance bank g uarantee (CPBG)/security deposit (SD) and EMD may be deducted from the bills of vendor which may be re leased after receipt of contract cum performance bank guarantee (CPBG)/security deposit (SD). In the event of non-execution of order, the EMD shall stand forfeited. Other conditions of forfeiture is m entioned in GeM GTC. 5. SECURITY DEPOSIT (SD): The successful bidder shall submit an interest free security deposit bank guarantee in Nalco's prescribed f ormat drawn from any of the list of banks approved by NALCO for 5 % of order value (excluding taxes) which will be valid period of 6 months beyond the committed delivery period towards fulfillment of obligati ons in the purchase order. Security deposit shall be returned to the seller after successful execution of the order subject to recovery of claim, if any. If the seller fails to submit security deposit BG or at his option eq uivalent BG after placement of order, the equivalent amount shall be deducted from the bill(s) of vendor w hich may be released after receipt of security deposit. SDBG format with bank list is attached in the ATC at tachment. Security Deposit can also be submitted in form of e-PBG. Format of BG is provided in ATC attachment Ann exure-I. Suppliers who choose to submit e-PBG through National E-Governance Services Limited (NeSL) pla tform, details of NALCO (Beneficiary) are provided in ATC attachment Annexure-II. Successful bidders can submit the security deposit in the form of payment online through RTGS /internet b anking also. On-line payment shall be made in the beneficiary name “National aluminium co. Ltd.” Acc ount no. 10657908114 IFSC code SBIN0008279 bank name SBI branch address Kandsar. Successful bi dder to indicate contract number and name of seller entity in the transaction details field at the time of on -line transfer. Bidder has to send scanned copy / proof of the online payment transfer in place of PBG withi n 15 days of award of contract to: naneeta.priyadarshini@nalcoindia.co.in. 6. PO quantity tolerance: Qty. Tolerance of +/- 5% order quantity shall be considered. SECTION-B 1. PRICE BASIS: Price is to be quoted firm and fixed for Nalco smelter stores basis including all cost comp onent i.e. P&F, freight & transit insurance, GST etc. 2. INCOME TAX CLAUSE: A. In compliance to income tax act, u/s 206ab & 206cca company will check the filing of income tax return for each of the two previous financial years for which due date for filling of income tax return has expired a nd also check linking of pan with Aadhaar as required under the act, with the help of facility provided by in

come tax department for deciding the TDS %. However this is as per current status and is subject to modifi cation based on further notification on the subject by govt. Of India under income tax act. B. Nalco, being (buyer (under section 194q inserted in the income tax act, 1961 vide finance act2021) havi ng total sales, gross receipts, or turnover from business above rupees ten crore during the last financial ye ar, will deduct TDS under section 194q, w.e.f. 01.07.2021, at the prescribed rate of 0.1% on the purchase v alue of any goods, aggregate of which is exceeding the threshold limit of Rs. 50 lakh in a financial year. Ac cordingly, vendor/sellers are not to collect tax at source under section 206c (1h) of the act w.e.f. 01.07.202 1, in case provisions of section are applicable to them. 3. DEBAR VENDORS: The bidders who are on holiday / negative list of NALCO as on due date of submissi on of bid / during the process of evaluation of the bids, the offers of such bidders shall not be considered fo r bid opening/ evaluation/award. 4. WEIGHMENT TOLERANCE: In case of weightment items, material will be weighed and accepted as pe r weighment recorded at Smelter Plant Weighbridge, with a tolerance of +/- 0.5% 5. MANDATORY DOCUMENTS TO BE SUBMITTED ALONG WITH THE BIDS Following documents must be submitted along with the bids, failing which, bids may be liable for rejection. A. All necessary documents related to Bidders’ Pre Qualification Criteria (PQC) complete in all respe ct, wherever applicable. It may be noted that, after submission of the bid, only related shortfall documents may be asked for and considered. For example, if the bidder has submitted a supply/ works order/contract document without its completion/performance certificate, the certificates can be asked for and considered. However, no new supply /works order/contract document shall be considered to qualify the bidder. B. Duly filled “Technical confirmation sheet” attached under “Buyer specification document” and “C onfirmation to commercial terms, ATC & GTC” attached under “Buyer uploaded ATC document”. C. Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) on or before bid end date and time, wherever applicable. D. Duly filled annexures attached under “Buyer uploaded ATC document”. E. Duly filled Integrity Pact (IP), wherever applicable. F. Any document which needs to be certified by a practicing chartered accountant (CA) or Cost Acc ountant (CMA/CWA) as per tender requirement, must bear a valid UDIN, without which, the document will not be accepted. G. Any other documents mentioned elsewhere, which is a part of bid evaluation. 6. MANDATORY DOCUMENTS TO BE SUBMITTED ALONG WITH THE SUPPLY A. Contract copy. B. Invoice copy & GeM invoice C. LR copy D. E-way bill (wherever required). E. Guarantee/Warranty certificate (wherever required). F. Test certificate (wherever required). G. Pre Dispatch Inspection (PDI) report (wherever required). H. Any other documents specifically mentioned elsewhere during the tender. Note: In the event of non-submission of the required documents as per contract condition, NALCO shall r eject all the supplied material. 7. PROCEDURE FOR CLARIFICATION (PRE/POST BID OPENING) A. Any clarification/representation against the bid document prior to bid opening, shall be sought by the bidders online in the GeM Portal i.e., through the GeM representation window only.

Queries/clarifications/representations which are received through any mode other than GeM portal (offline mode or e-mail, etc.) will not be considered/entertained. B. During bid evaluation, any clarification/shortfall documents shall be sought on GeM portal throug h clarification window. Bidders must submit the same on the portal. C. Through the representation window for rejected bidders, a bidder can submit their representation regarding a wrong evaluation of their bids. 8.
